label: Slack: Await Action
description: The approval pattern: post a message with buttons, pause the workflow until someone clicks, then continue with which button was chosen and by whom. The message is edited once decided so the buttons cannot be clicked twice. Works through the app's interactivity delivery (the shared app's configured interactivity URL, or your own app's Socket Mode).

inputs.name: account
inputs.description: The Slack access (wire a SlackAccess node). Needs the chat:write scope.

inputs.name: channel
inputs.label: Channel
inputs.placeholder: Pick a channel or paste its id

inputs.name: text
inputs.label: Text
inputs.description: The question or context shown above the buttons (mrkdwn).

inputs.name: buttons
inputs.label: Buttons
inputs.description: The choices, e.g. [{"id": "approve", "label": "Approve", "style": "primary"}, {"id": "reject", "label": "Reject", "style": "danger"}]. The clicked button's id comes out the action output.

inputs.name: confirmedText
inputs.label: Text after the decision
inputs.description: What the message becomes once someone clicked. Defaults to the original text plus who chose what.
